description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify performance, and AI‑driven edge‑ready routing for serverless and edge workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages AI‑generated route maps and edge‑function compilation to deliver sub‑millisecond latency while staying under 5 KB of zero‑dependency code. Full compatibility with Express middleware and Fastify plugins lets teams adopt it instantly, and built‑in observability dashboards make performance tuning effortless—exactly the mix of speed, intelligence, and simplicity that 2026 developers search for.
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond request latency on edge VMs and serverless containers.
AI‑powered route generation slashes boilerplate by up to 80 %.
Zero‑dependency core keeps the bundle <5 KB, ideal for edge and serverless deployments.
Built‑in observability & telemetry dashboards give instant insight without extra packages.
Drop‑in compatibility with existing Express middleware and Fastify plugins for frictionless migration.
